intro: Our villa interior design shapes how a family lives in a house. Lumeria is a seven-bedroom waterfront villa on Palm Jumeirah. Solari puts six distinct social zones on a single floor, on a private stretch of Palm Jumeirah. Soul, at La Mer, joins architecture and interior design in one project.

seo.title: Villa Interior Design Projects | Nellis Architecture
seo.description: Villa interior design by Nellis Architecture in Dubai: waterfront homes on Palm Jumeirah and La Mer, designed around how a family lives, gathers and rests.
